summary: Loads a cube map MAS file into an object whose layout starts with a filename buffer and a file handle. Copies the caller's filename into this+0x14, opens the file (sub_587DB0) first at the direct path and then, on failure, through each registered audio entry directory (byte_8B5A3C, stride 0x84, count dword_8B8E30) building "%s\%s" candidates; stores the handle in this+0x10. If every open attempt fails it logs and returns -2. It then reads a 12-byte header and validates it with strcmp against aCubemas410, aCubemas400 and aCubemas401; a mismatch closes the file, logs, and returns -1. On success it reads header fields, derives the data size as (field@0x118 << 8), allocates that many bytes (OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper), stores the pointer in this+0x128, reads the payload, then bumps this+0x11C by 24. Returns 0 on success, -1 on invalid/empty input or allocation failure, -2 when the file cannot be opened anywhere.

operations.description: Guard on a2 (filename): if a2 is NULL or its first byte is '\0', return -1 immediately.
Copy the caller filename string a2 into the object's filename buffer at this+0x14 (byte-wise copy terminated by the null byte).
Call sub_589901 on the copied filename (this+0x14) to normalize/prepare it.
Open the file: sub_587DB0(filename, aRb) using the literal "rb" mode string.
Store the file handle returned by the open call into this+0x10.
Guard on the stored handle (this+0x10) being zero: enter the audio-entry directory search fallback.

Iterate the registered audio entry array byte_8B5A3C (stride 0x84) for dword_8B8E30 entries; per entry build a "%s\%s" path with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and retry the open (sub_587DB0), stopping on the first success and storing the new handle in this+0x10.

Guard for total open failure (search index v7 reached dword_8B8E30 without a handle): format "Error opening MAS file %s" via StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck, log it through sub_53C590(-2, message) and return -2.
Thread-safe read of the 12-byte header magic from the file into the object start (ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f(this, 1, 12, handle)).

Guard on header validation: if the 12-byte header string at this differs from aCubemas410, aCubemas400 and aCubemas401 (all three strcmp non-zero), the file is not a recognized cube map MAS; close the handle (FileCloseWithLock), log aIncorrectMasFi via sub_53C590(-1, ...) and return -1.
Read three 4-byte header fields (including the field at this+0x118) from the file (ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f on this+0x114, this+0x118 and this+0x120).
Compute the data size as v12 = (field@this+0x118) << 8 and store it into this+0x11C.
Allocate the data buffer of v12 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and store the returned pointer into this+0x128.
Guard on allocation failure: if the stored buffer pointer (this+0x128) is NULL, close the file (FileCloseWithLock), log aUnableToAlloca via sub_53C590(-1, ...) and return -1.
Thread-safe read of the payload into the allocated buffer (ThreadSafeReadWrapper_803f(buffer, 1, field@this+0x11C, handle)).
Adjust the stored data size: this+0x11C += 24 (accounts for the header/footer overhead on top of the payload).
Return 0 on success; negative values (-1, -2) on the error paths above.
